intro:
These packages are a starting point and can be adjusted to your needs.
Share your ideas through the contact form or LINE for a tailored quote.

packages.name: Portrait Session
packages.description: For personal branding, birthdays and graduation portraits.
includes: Online gallery delivered within 7 business days

packages.name: Wedding Coverage
packages.description: Capture the important moments throughout your wedding day.
includes: All delivered photographs color-graded (approximately 400 or more)

packages.name: Commercial & Brand Photography
packages.description: Product images, brand campaigns, interiors and team portraits.
includes: Pre-session discussion of requirements and style
Files sized for web or print use

process.title: Get in Touch
process.text: Use the form or LINE to share your session type, preferred date and ideas.

process.title: Confirm Your Quote
process.text: After discussing the details, I will provide a quote. A deposit secures your date once you confirm.

process.title: Your Session
process.text: Relax and enjoy the session. I will take care of the photography.

process.title: Receive Your Photographs
process.text: Color-graded and retouched photographs are delivered within your package's timeframe.

notes: A 30% deposit is due after confirming your date.
Travel fees apply outside Taipei and New Taipei City.
One free rescheduling is available if weather affects the session.
